title: Deeper/broader open-source peer route and artifact-status refresh
mode: Primary-source web research and local plan reconciliation; plan-only
scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF peer release identity and route boundaries.
Distinguish DWG reader/writer, DXF parser/writer, OGR projection, raw-carrier, geometry-kernel, and native consumer evidence.
Disambiguate LibreDWG 0.14 and 0.14.1 milestone states and preserve fast local implementation cadence.

sources.revision: 0.14 release tag d9468ae; mutable release/NEWS pages accessed 2026-10-22; latest listed prerelease 0.14.8612 at f860b0f
sources.observed: The 0.14 release says R2004 DWG writing is supported and R2010/R2013/R2018 writing is experimental with CRC errors on import. The 0.14 milestone closed Sep 8, 2026, while the separate 0.14.1 milestone remains open at 67% with 13 open issues. The 0.14.1 NEWS is beta and the latest listed 0.14.8612 artifact is a prerelease/nightly.
sources.limits: The two milestone states, beta NEWS, mutable master, pre-release artifacts, and the stable 0.14 release are distinct identities. No artifact was downloaded, built, or executed.

sources.revision: Latest formal release page accessed 2026-10-22; v3.8.0 signed commit 3a1c66b; issue #1195 report states ACadSharp 3.4.9
sources.observed: v3.8.0 remains the latest formal release. Its v3.7.1 predecessor release notes include reading ACIS payloads from 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY and reading the AcDs payload-area offset. Issue #1195 remains open and reports silent modeler-entity omission against 3.4.9, not a reproduced result for v3.8.0.
sources.limits: No package or peer source was run. Old issue behavior cannot be projected onto a newer release without route-matched reproduction.

sources.observed: libopencad states support for DWG R2000 only. GDAL's CAD driver is based on libopencad, is read-only, and exposes a small OGR geometry subset; inferring that it is not a complete DWG object-graph interface follows from the projected schema and documented entity list.
sources.limits: This route is not useful as a broad post-AC1015 DWG reader, writer, AcDs, or solid-semantics oracle. No build/run occurred.

sources.observed: GDAL 3.12 adds Binary-DXF read. The DXF driver projects source records into OGR geometry and documents tessellation, merged/inlined blocks by default, omitted styling/schema details, and AC1027+ optional raw ASMData/ASMTransform without converting ASM to OGR geometry.
sources.limits: OGR projection is not full document preservation, a DWG route, ACIS/B-rep semantics, or native CAD acceptance. No GDAL build or output was inspected.

sources.observed: ezdxf documents versioned ASCII/Binary DXF support and ACIS tools for simple known structures, but explicitly excludes loading/editing arbitrary ACIS and states it has no ACIS kernel. Its DXF interface is not a DWG codec or format converter; external DWG conversions belong to the separately installed converter.
sources.limits: No DWG codec or arbitrary-solid geometry-kernel result follows from ezdxf. No package/tool was run.

sources.revision: Mutable source/docs accessed 2026-10-22; current local support-status file
sources.observed: The DWG route converts through a selected external converter to DXF and then runs the selected DXF importer. The current wrapper's LibreDWG path checks output-file existence after subprocess completion and automatic mode can attempt other converters.
sources.limits: Native qualification must pin and separately measure converter and importer stages; wrapper success or entity count alone does not establish exact converter attribution or geometry validity. No native application was run.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8 route-matched optional peer selection and per-source dispositions
PAR-14 release/source/artifact identity pinning and no per-slice peer runtime
Native FreeCAD converter/importer/platform stages remain separately attributable
Clarified distinct LibreDWG 0.14 and 0.14.1 milestone states and retained stable-release writer limits

planChanges: Confirmed that the previously reported 0.14.1 milestone remains open, distinguished it from the closed 0.14 milestone, and kept the latest 0.14.8612 artifact identified as prerelease/nightly while preserving stable 0.14 writer limitations.
Recorded libopencad/GDAL CAD as an AC1015-limited read-only geometry projection route, not a broad DWG/3D peer.
Tightened GDAL DXF use to exact-version configured OGR projection/raw-carrier observation; Binary-DXF support is not DWG support and raw ASM is not modeler semantics.
Kept ACadSharp issue #1195 scoped to its reported 3.4.9 route and did not infer current v3.8.0 behavior from it.
Reaffirmed FreeCAD converter/importer separation, strict route attribution, the no-external-fixture policy, focused-test cadence, and non-promoting J gates.
Corrected the most recent PAR-134 self-unblock text so completed PAR-140/7N.4 work is not queued a second time.
limitations: GitHub release, milestone, issue, and source pages are mutable; all observations are timestamped and no peer artifact was pinned or executed here.
Peer documentation/source establishes route classification only; it is not ODA byte-layout authority, a local reproduction, independent semantic evidence, or native CAD acceptance.
The research did not resolve any of J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, or J295.
